caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot, centered on a plain, light-colored background. The teapot is outlined in black ink, with a round body, a curved spout on the left, and a large, rounded handle on the right. The spout features a segmented design near its base, while the handle and the small round knob on the teapot's lid are filled in with solid black, contrasting with the rest of the outline. The teapot sits on a circular, stepped base also defined by simple black lines. Below the center of the teapot, there is a small label or signature reading "Polivnik". In the lower right corner, another signature says "Lawrence Flynn" in cursive handwriting. The overall composition is clean, with the teapot rendered in a symmetric, profile view, and no other objects or background elements present.
title: Silver Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
